faces.transcription: Return all Checkpoint tokens on the board to the supply.
faces.flavor: The Soviets were transporting a large quantity of thin sheets of rubberized silk from Jade Manufacturing, and they were sparing no effort to keep it a secret. Still, you managed to tie up their delivery in customs and paperwork indefinitely.
